name: opening_range_breakout_30_v1
mechanism: NIFTY and BANKNIFTY spend the first 30 minutes (09:15-09:45 IST) absorbing overnight positioning, gap adjustments, and the first wave of institutional TWAP/VWAP flow. By 09:45, these forces are largely exhausted and the resulting OR high/low represents a genuine equilibrium boundary — wider and more robust than the 20-minute ORB because it absorbs the early retail momentum flushes too. When NIFTY/BANKNIFTY closes 3 consecutive 5-second bars above the OR high with above-average volume and price above VWAP, the supply ceiling has been systematically consumed by institutional buy-side flow, not spiked through by a single block. At 5-second resolution we enter within 15 seconds of confirmed breakout, capturing the initial 15-25 spot point directional thrust before the move extends into the next resistance zone or stalls.
core_signal_oneliner: 30-minute opening range breakout with 3-bar (15s) close persistence above OR boundary, VWAP alignment, and 2x volume vs OR-period average confirming institutional commitment
